common:synonyms.#text: Soapless soaps; Synthetic cleaning compounds; Non-soapy cleaning agent
无皂洗涤剂；合成清洁剂；非皂类清洁剂

common:generalComment.#text: Detergent is a surfactant or a mixture of surfactants with cleansing properties when in dilute solutions. Conventionally, detergent is used to mean synthetic cleaning compounds as opposed to soap. They are chemically different from soaps but are able to emulsify oils, hold dirt in suspension, and act as wetting agents. Detergents are not prepared from fats and oils, are not inactivated by hard water, and have wetting-agent and emulsifying-agent properties. They are effective even in hard or saltwater, unlike soaps, because they do not develop scum.
洗涤剂是一种表面活性剂或表面活性剂混合物，在稀释溶液中具有清洁特性。通常，洗涤剂指的是合成清洁化合物，而不是肥皂。它们与肥皂的化学性质不同，但能乳化油，使污垢悬浮，并起到润湿剂的作用。洗涤剂不是由油脂制备的，不会被硬水灭活，具有润湿剂和乳化剂的特性。它们与肥皂不同，即使在硬水或盐水中也有效，因为它们不会产生浮渣。

common:generalComment.#text: Tap water refers to water that has been processed for safety and compliance with drinking water standards and is commonly supplied to households and industries via plumbing systems. It is treated to remove contaminants and pathogens, typically involving processes such as filtration, sedimentation, and disinfection. This water is ready for direct consumption or use in various applications 'to consumer' and 'at plant'. The specific treatment methods and quality can vary depending on the location and local water source.

common:generalComment.#text: Polyethylene is a plastic film made from ethylene, a hydrocarbon mainly obtained from natural gas or oil. It is commonly used in packaging for pharmaceuticals, household chemicals, and food items. There are different types of polyethylene film, influenced by the degree and form of side branching from the polymer chain. Polyethylene terephthalates are solid forms of polyester, and rival polyethylene in packaging applications.
聚乙烯是一种由乙烯制成的塑料薄膜，乙烯是一种碳氢化合物，主要从天然气或石油中提取。它常用于药品、家用化学品和食品的包装。聚乙烯薄膜有不同的类型，受聚合物链的侧枝程度和形式的影响。聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯是聚酯的固态形式，在包装应用中可与聚乙烯相媲美。
